title: urachne ramosa
intro: Urachne ramosa, commonly known as the hair grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues, inflammation, and fever. The therapeutic actions of Urachne ramosa include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
